name: I Met Her Once
source:
You're driving to see an old friend who lives out in the country when you experience two unfortunate events: your phone dies, and your car gets a flat tire.

Making your way to the nearest house, you now have to wait for someone to arrive and pick you up. 

How will you spend your time?

[From [url=https://pixelatedinkbottle.itch.io/i-met-her-once]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你开车去看望一位住在乡下的老朋友，这时你遇到了两件不幸的事情：手机没电了，汽车轮胎漏气了。

在前往最近的房子时，你现在必须等待有人来接你。

你将如何度过你的时间？

[来自[url=https://pixelatedinkbottle.itch.io/i-met-her-once]Itch.io[/url]]
